chunks: He said: Hannan ibn Sadir narrated to me from Abu Ismail al-Abrus from Abu Basir who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: Deliverance is on the seventh of us.

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, a title for Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him).
key_terms.السَّابِعُ: The seventh, referring to the seventh Imam in the lineage.
key_terms.الْفَرَجُ: Deliverance or relief, referring to the emergence or reappearance of the Imam.

ai.seo_question: Who is the seventh Imam according to this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* explicitly identifies Imam Musa al-Kadhim (a.s.) as the seventh Imam, thereby confirming his Imamate against the Waqifiya who halted their belief at Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq. The phrase 'on the head of the seventh' signifies that the ultimate deliverance (al-Faraj) is intrinsically linked to his era and authority, serving as a crucial theological proof for the continuity of the Imamate through the progeny of Husayn.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 45 - Narrated to me Hannan bin Sudair from Abu Ismail Abras from Abu Basir that he said:
Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) said: Deliverance is on the seventh (Imam) of us.
